title: Naval units in the Goblin look: ramshackle scrap junk-boats with patched brown leather sails, barrels, a stray firework and an olive crew, and their portraits

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin junk-boat: the pale hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with two riveted gunmetal grey scrap iron plates; the red sail becomes patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with three stitched square patches of pale hide; the red pennant becomes a torn brown rag. Keep the boat shape, mast, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 cog rebuilt as a scrap junk-boat: planks, scrap plates and a patched leather sail by hex values, as the Goblin production recoloured leather.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin scrap warship: the pale hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with riveted gunmetal scrap plates; the grey stone tower becomes rusty scrap iron; the red sails become patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with stitched hide patches; the pennants become brown rags. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 carrack rebuilt as a scrap warship.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin raft: the pale hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows lashed with rope and a gunmetal scrap plate; the red tarp becomes patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with stitched hide patches; two small wooden barrels sit beside the cargo; the pennant becomes a brown rag. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 barge rebuilt as a scrap raft with barrels.

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin junk-boat: the hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with a riveted gunmetal scrap plate; the red sail becomes patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with two stitched pale hide patches; the pennant becomes a brown rag. Keep the boat shape, mast, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.

Turn it into a ramshackle goblin scrap warship: the hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with riveted gunmetal scrap plates; the grey castles become rusty scrap iron; the red sails become patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with stitched pale hide patches; the pennants become brown rags. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.

Recolour only the orange sail: it becomes dull desaturated mid-brown leather like an old saddle, colour #8a4a1c with #5a2e10 shadows, not orange; its stitched square patches stay pale hide. Keep everything else, the boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: goblin-patrol-boat-scrap-a has the junk-boat (dark planks, scrap plates, patched sail) but the sail came out ochre-orange, the Dinosaur accent's family; the Goblin production's saddle wording brings it to brown leather.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the orange sails: they become dull desaturated mid-brown leather like an old saddle, colour #8a4a1c with #5a2e10 shadows, not orange; their stitched patches stay darker brown. Keep everything else, the boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: goblin-battleship-scrap-a has the scrap warship but ochre-orange sails.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the orange tarp over the cargo: it becomes dull desaturated mid-brown leather like an old saddle, colour #8a4a1c with #5a2e10 shadows, not orange; its stitched patches stay. Keep everything else, the boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: goblin-transport-scrap-a has the raft with barrels but an ochre-orange tarp.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the orange sail: it becomes dull desaturated mid-brown leather like an old saddle, colour #8a4a1c with #5a2e10 shadows, not orange; its pale patches stay. Keep everything else, the boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: The first portrait edit has an orange sail.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the orange sails: they become dull desaturated mid-brown leather like an old saddle, colour #8a4a1c with #5a2e10 shadows, not orange; their patches stay. Keep everything else, the boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: The first portrait edit has orange sails.

recipes.editInstruction: Add one little olive-green goblin, skin colour #8a952f, with long pointed ears sticking out sideways and a big cheeky grin, standing on the deck in front of the mast and leaning over the rail, waving. Keep the dark planks, the scrap plates, the brown leather sail with its patches, the pennant, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: goblin-patrol-boat-saddle-edit-a has the right junk-boat and a brown leather sail, but nothing on it says Goblin at native size: an olive goblin with the faction's sideways ears does.

recipes.editInstruction: Add one little olive-green goblin, skin colour #8a952f, with long pointed ears sticking out sideways and a big cheeky grin, standing in the scrap iron lookout tower and shouting. Keep the dark planks, scrap plates, brown leather sails, pennants, ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: goblin-battleship-saddle-edit-a is a dark scrap warship with brown sails; a goblin in the tower gives it the faction's olive and ears.

recipes.editInstruction: Add one little olive-green goblin, skin colour #8a952f, with long pointed ears sticking out sideways and a big cheeky grin, sitting on top of the brown leather tarp over the cargo. Keep the dark planks, oars, barrels, the tarp, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: goblin-transport-saddle-edit-a is a dark raft with a brown tarp and barrels; a goblin on the cargo makes it the Goblins'.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the dark maroon red hull planks and oars: they become dark brown wood, colour #4a2c14 with #2a1608 shadows, not red and not maroon. Keep the olive goblin, the barrels, the scrap plates, the pennant, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: goblin-transport-crew-edit-a is right, but its hull is a dark maroon (hue 350): 6.8% of its pixels fall in the owner key's band (hue 340 to 5, saturated).
Batch stage (only after the sample passes review): a fresh creation of the patrol boat in direction A.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: erase the white and blue water, waves and foam under the hull, so the boat floats alone on a transparent background with nothing under it. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, the tin patches, the sail with its yellow patch, the firework rocket, the goblin, the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Retry of patrol-boat-a-edit, whose job failed at PixelLab (its recipe stays recorded as submitted).
Batch stage (only after the sample passes review): a fresh creation of the battleship in direction A.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the two flags: the blue flag on top of the lookout tower and the red flag on the mast both become hazard yellow rags, colour #fdd20f. Nothing blue and nothing red is left on the flags. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, the tin plates, the sails, the lookout tower, the barrels, the firework spark, the goblin, the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: Batch iteration 2 (bead pulp_wars-wrn.2): a red and a blue flag read as player colours (the pennant shows the owner).
Batch stage (only after the sample passes review): a fresh creation of the transport in direction A.

recipes.editInstruction: Remove the mast, the sail and the knob on top of the mast completely, so it is a low open rowing raft with no mast and no sail; where the sail was there is only transparent background. The goblin's red bandana becomes a pale sand-buff leather cap. Keep the hull, the tin patches, the oars, the cargo, the small yellow rag, the goblin's green face, the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Batch iteration 2 (bead pulp_wars-wrn.2): the embarked transport has no mast and no sail in any faction, so it never reads as a warship; red cloth is excluded.
Batch stage (only after the sample passes review): a fresh creation of the portrait patrol boat in direction A.
Batch stage (only after the sample passes review): a fresh creation of the portrait battleship in direction A.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only two small parts: the pink inside of the goblin's big ear becomes pale lime green, colour #acdc55, with no pink and no red left on the goblin; and the small blue flag on top of the lookout tower becomes hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, the tin plates, the sails, the lookout tower, the barrels, the firework spark, the yellow rag, the goblin's face, the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: Production fix (bead pulp_wars-wrn.2): the goblin's ear was salmon pink (#f96a68, 13 pixels within 12 of the Coral player colour, caught by the naval asset test), and the top flag stayed teal.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only one small part: the little goblin's pink face and head become bright lime green, colour #86c232, with a lighter #acdc55 nose and cheeks, like his green ear; no pink, no red and no salmon is left on the goblin. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, the tin plates, the sails, the lookout tower, the two yellow flags, the barrels, the firework spark, the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: Production fix 2 (bead pulp_wars-wrn.2): battleship-a-edit-2 made both flags yellow and the ear green, but turned the goblin's face pink.
